market_outlook.short_term: Volatile. Oil supported by Yemen/Iran geopolitics; yen strength pressures USD and U.S. yields; AI names bifurcate on execution quality. Auto sector under pressure from recalls. U.S. debt narrative keeps Treasury yields elevated near 4.8%.
market_outlook.long_term: Fiscal sustainability question dominates 2026-2027. AI capex cycle likely continues but with greater dispersion. India and EM capital markets deepen. Energy transition policy (NEV, hydrogen) creates structural winners. Auto sector consolidates via quality differentiation.
